evals.prompt: I'm getting a 'Two output files share the same path but have different contents: out/auth.js' error when running convex dev. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Runs `rm -f convex/*.js` to clean orphan .js files, then retries `npx convex dev`. Explains that only .ts files belong in convex/.

assertions.name: cleans-orphan-js-files
assertions.description: Runs `rm -f convex/*.js` to remove orphan JavaScript files before retrying

assertions.name: explains-root-cause
assertions.description: Explains that orphan .js files in convex/ directory cause the 'Two output files' error (from worktrees, crashes, or manual ops)

assertions.name: uses-npx-convex-not-raw-node
assertions.description: Uses `npx convex dev` (or the skill's dev script) rather than running node/bun directly against convex internals

evals.prompt: Deploy the Convex backend to production for the golems project.
evals.expected_output: Checks for convex/ directory first, cleans .js files, then runs `npx convex deploy` or the deploy script. Mentions CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY if needed.

assertions.name: checks-convex-directory-exists
assertions.description: Verifies the convex/ directory exists before running deploy commands (project detection step)

assertions.name: auto-cleans-before-command
assertions.description: Prefixes with `rm -f convex/*.js` cleanup as per the CRITICAL auto-clean rule

assertions.name: uses-npx-convex-deploy
assertions.description: Uses `npx convex deploy` or the deploy.sh script for production deployment

evals.prompt: I need to export a backup of all Convex data and then run the query api.users.getAll to check something.
evals.expected_output: Runs `npx convex export --path ./backup.zip` for the backup, then `npx convex run api.users.getAll` for the query. Both prefixed with js cleanup.

assertions.name: uses-convex-export-command
assertions.description: Uses `npx convex export --path <file>` or the export script to create a data backup

assertions.name: uses-convex-run-for-function
assertions.description: Uses `npx convex run api.users.getAll` (or the run-function script) to execute the query

assertions.name: backup-before-destructive-ops
assertions.description: If any import or schema change is mentioned, ensures backup is taken first per safety rules
